content:
September 22, 7:04 PM update: Apple has released the corresponding public candidate versions, with the same build numbers as the second developer candidate versions.

Less than a week after rolling out the RC versions of macOS 26.7.1 and macOS 15.8.1, Apple is now releasing the second candidate builds in preparation for the official launch. Here are the details.

Second candidate versions of macOS 26.7.1 and 15.8.1 are now available

Last week, Apple released the first candidate versions of macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1. On the same day, the company released macOS 27.2 beta 1, rather than the macOS 27.1 beta 1 and its counterparts that most users and developers were expecting.

macOS 27.2 beta 1 introduces Siri AI support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish, while the beta versions of macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 are relatively uneventful, with Apple stating only that they "provide important security fixes and are recommended for all users to install."

Apple is likely to disclose the related security details in the coming weeks when macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 are officially released.

The build number of macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 RC 2 is 25G313, while the second RC of macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 carries the build number 24H212.

Have you spotted any new features in this RC release? Let us know in the comments.
